t: The Federal building located at 100 North Palafox Street in Pensacola, Florida, shall be known and designated as the “Winston E. Arnow Federal Building”.

fable.w: This section only names a federal building; Congress makes the designation directly by statute. No outside party is consulted, no hearing, comment, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue is involved, so there is no participation.
fable.s: shall be known and designated as the “Winston E. Arnow Federal Building”
